MAPPING.DESCRIPTION: This mapping loads GENERATION_UNIT_FDR from POWERMANAGER source tables Has insert/update logic **************************************************************** *Christina Wee 03/10/2012 Created
MAPPING.NAME: m_FEL_PWRMGR_GNRTN_UNIT_FDR_ins_upd

TABLEATTRIBUTE.NAME: Sql Query
TABLEATTRIBUTE.VALUE: SELECT u.UNITNAME , u.UNITID , u.UNITTYPECODE , u.ISO , u.BLACK_START , u.LOADING_CHAR , u.PRIMARY_FUEL_CODE , u.SECONDARY_FUEL_CODE , u.TERTIARY_FUEL_CODE , u.QUARTERNARY_FUEL_CODE , u.PITAG , u.COMMERCIALDATE , ut.unittype , uo.utilityname FROM PMGR.UNIT U inner join (select UNITID, max(EFFECTIVEDATE) as m_EFFECTIVEDATE from PMGR.UNIT group by UNITID ) m on u.unitid = m.unitid and u.EFFECTIVEDATE = m.m_EFFECTIVEDATE left outer join PMGR.Unit_Type ut on u.UNITTYPECODE = ut.unittypecode left outer join PMGR.utility_operator uo on u.UTILITY = uo.utility

TABLEATTRIBUTE.NAME: Lookup Sql Override
TABLEATTRIBUTE.VALUE: SELECT FC.DESCRIPTION as DESCRIPTION , TRIM(FC.CODE) as CODE FROM PMGR.FUEL_CODE FC

TABLEATTRIBUTE.NAME: Lookup Sql Override
TABLEATTRIBUTE.VALUE: SELECT F.FUEL_CD_DESCN_TX as FUEL_CD_DESCN_TX , UPPER(TRIM(F.FUEL_CD)) as FUEL_CD FROM FELADM.FEL_FUEL_CODE_FDR F

TABLEATTRIBUTE.NAME: Lookup Sql Override
TABLEATTRIBUTE.VALUE: SELECT TRIM(U.UNIT_ID) as UNIT_ID FROM FELADM.FEL_PWRMGR_GNRTN_UNIT_FDR U
